dictionary.commands_unpaired: Node not paired: pair it from Nodes & Servers to control it.
dictionary.commands_none: No commands available on this node.
dictionary.feedback_queued: {command}: sent, the node will run it on next contact (within 30 s).
dictionary.confirm_reboot_local: The server will reboot in 2 seconds: the console will be unreachable until it is back online.
dictionary.confirm_reboot_remote: {name} will receive the command on next contact and reboot.
dictionary.confirm_restart_local: The Nuxiva supervisor will restart: the console will reconnect automatically.
dictionary.confirm_restart_remote: The agent on {name} will restart on next contact.
dictionary.confirm_update_remote: {name} will download and install the updated agent.
dictionary.confirm_setup_local: The guided setup reappears on the home screen: you can change the assistant's name, voice, language and services. People, data and settings stay saved until you change them.
